Available September 2024 · £150pppw · Furnished to a high standard

My Property Box are pleased to market this two bedroom student property in the heart of the City Centre directly opposite Fenwick's Department Store, just moments away from the Universities. This student property is superbly located on one of Newcastle's prestige shopping streets and offers access to countless local shops, bars and amenities in the City Centre and the Quayside. Northumberland Street is close to bus, metro and rail links into other areas. The property is well presented and accommodation comprises; communal entrance with with security video entry & private mail boxes, reception hallway, lounge, kitchen, flat screen TV in lounge and bedroom. The property is quadruple Glazed. Kitchen has dishwasher, washer/ dryer, electric hob and oven, electric heating and high standard interior. Call My Property Box to arrange a viewing today.
